US 01.01.01.description: As an entrant, I want to search for campsites.

US 01.01.02.description: As an entrant, I want to filter campsites by location, date, and number of guests.

US 01.01.03.description: As an entrant, I want to see a list of campsites based on my filters.

US 01.01.04.description: As an entrant, I want to see campsite summary information including name, location, maximum occupancy, and rating.

US 01.01.05.description: As an entrant, I want to see details of a campsite.

US 01.01.06.description: As an entrant, I want to join an active lottery from the campsite details screen.

US 01.02.01.description: As an entrant, I want to join the waiting list for a campsite lottery.

US 01.02.02.description: As an entrant, I want to leave the waiting list for a campsite lottery.

US 01.03.01.description: As an entrant, I want to receive a notification when I win the campsite lottery.
US 01.03.01.note: The Inbox illustrates a winning notification; push delivery requires Android/Firebase implementation.

US 01.03.02.description: As an entrant, I want to receive a notification when I lose the campsite lottery.
US 01.03.02.note: A lost-result screen exists, but an entrant-facing lost-notification example is still missing.

US 01.04.01.description: As an entrant, if I win the lottery, I want to see available dates that I can reserve the campsite for.

US 01.04.02.description: As an entrant, if I win a multiple campsite lottery, I want to choose which campsite to reserve and which dates I want.

US 01.04.03.description: As an entrant, if I win the lottery, I want to decline a reservation if I changed my mind or if none of the remaining dates work for me.

US 01.05.01.description: As an entrant, I want to receive confirmation of my campsite reservation.

US 01.05.02.description: As an entrant, I want to receive reservation by notification or downloadable CSV.

US 01.06.01.description: As an entrant, I want to view a list of my active reservations.

US 01.06.02.description: As an entrant, I want to view a list of my past reservations.

US 01.07.01.description: As an entrant, I want to cancel my campsite reservation.

US 01.07.02.description: As an entrant, I want to receive confirmation of my campsite cancellation by notification or downloadable CSV.

US 01.07.03.description: As an entrant, I want to update my personal information, such as name, email, and phone number, on my profile.

US 01.08.01.description: As an entrant, I want to delete my profile.

US 01.09.01.description: As an entrant, I want to be identified by my device, so that I do not have to use a username and password.
US 01.09.01.note: Password-free setup is illustrated; device identification requires Android implementation.

US 01.10.01.description: As an entrant, I want to opt out of receiving notifications.

US 01.11.01.description: As an entrant, I want to see the app policy and guidelines.

US 01.12.01.description: As an entrant, I want to view campsite details by scanning the promotional QR code.
US 01.12.01.note: The scanner entry and campsite destination are illustrated; the platform scanner is not simulated.

US 01.13.01.description: As an entrant, I want to give a rating for a campsite.

US 02.01.01.description: As a campsite owner, I want to register my campsite with the app.

US 02.01.02.description: As a campsite owner, I want to provide campsite details including name, location, description (amenities), maximum occupancy, map location, optional image, and tags.

US 02.01.03.description: As a campsite owner, I want to update details about my campsite.

US 02.01.04.description: As a campsite owner, I want to view details of my campsite.

US 02.02.01.description: As a campsite owner, I want the system to generate a unique QR code that links to the campsite details.

US 02.03.01.description: As a campsite owner, I want to view a list of my campsites.

US 02.04.01.description: As a campsite owner, I want to list my campsite in a lottery for a certain period.

US 02.04.02.description: As a campsite owner, I want be able to list multiple campsites in a lottery for a certain period.

US 02.04.03.description: As a campsite owner, I want to set a registration period.

US 02.04.04.description: As a campsite owner, I want to set a booking period.

US 02.04.05.description: As a campsite owner, I want to set the number of lottery winners.

US 02.04.06.description: As a campsite owner, I want to update my campsite lottery listing.

US 02.04.07.description: As a campsite owner, I want to optionally set a capacity for my lottery waitlist.

US 02.05.01.description: As a campsite owner, I want the system to automatically draw winners after the registration period ends.
US 02.05.01.note: Drawing and result states are illustrated; automatic triggering at registration close is not demonstrated by the manual fallback journey.

US 02.06.01.description: As a campsite owner, I want to view the currently booked dates for my campsite.

US 02.07.01.description: As a campsite owner, I want to view a list of active reservations.

US 02.07.02.description: As a campsite owner, I want to view a list of past reservations.

US 02.07.03.description: As a campsite owner, I want to view a list of cancelled reservations.

US 02.08.01.description: As a campsite owner, I want to reject a reservation.

US 02.09.01.description: As a campsite owner, I want to view a list of entrants who have joined the waitlist for my campsite lottery.

US 02.10.01.description: As a campsite owner, I want to send notifications to entrants who have joined the waitlist for my campsite lottery.

US 02.10.02.description: As a campsite owner, I want to view a list of all notifications I have sent.

US 02.11.01.description: As a campsite owner, I want entrants to confirm that they have read the campsite rules and policies before confirming their reservation.

US 02.12.01.description: As a campsite owner, I want to message a user who is reserving my campsite.

US 03.01.01.description: As an admin, I want to remove registered campsites.

US 03.02.01.description: As an admin, I want to remove profiles.

US 03.03.01.description: As an admin, I want to remove images.

US 03.04.01.description: As an admin, I want to browse campsites.

US 03.05.01.description: As an admin, I want to browse profiles.

US 03.06.01.description: As an admin, I want to browse uploaded images so I can remove them if necessary.

US 03.07.01.description: As an admin, I want to remove campsite owners that violate app policy.

US 03.08.01.description: As an admin, I want to review logs of all notifications.

US 03.11.01.description: As an admin, I should be able to be a campsite owner and/or entrant with my admin profile.

US 03.12.01.description: As an admin, I want to review logs of all messages from campsite owners to entrants who reserved their campsite.

Feature 1.description: Owners draw reservation opportunities from a lottery waiting list.

Feature 2.description: Owners set campsite availability and winners reserve available dates.

Feature 3.description: Scan a promotional QR code to open a campsite and its active lottery.
Feature 3.note: QR display, scanner entry, and campsite destinations are illustrated; scanning uses a platform integration.

Feature 4.description: Use Firebase for campsite data, reservation lists, and real-time status updates.
Feature 4.note: Persistence and real-time synchronization require implementation and tests; no screen alone demonstrates this feature.

Feature 5.description: Provide entrant, owner, and administrator workspaces and privileges.

Feature 6.description: Upload campsite promotional images and entrant profile images.
Feature 6.note: Upload controls and image examples are illustrated; the prototype does not upload files.

Feature 7.description: Attach campsite coordinates and display the campsite location on a map.

WOW 1.description: View past and active reservations on a map.

WOW 2.description: Rank campsites using a match score based on the entrant's filters.

WOW 3.description: View campsites on a map within a selected radius of the device location.

WOW 4.description: Reply to reviews in threads and react to reviews.

WOW 5.description: Browse a featured campsite carousel based on camping preferences.
WOW 5.note: Featured content and preference inputs are illustrated; personalization and carousel interaction require implementation.

WOW 6.description: Offer colorblind mode and adjustable font, button, and component sizes.

WOW 7.description: Exchange messages between entrants and campsite owners about reservations.

journeys.title: Moderate and inspect logs
journeys.description: Browse campsites, profiles, images, notification and message logs.

journeys.description: Review the conflict state and return to date selection.
